Hi Lina —

Thanks again for the time last week. Based on OrbitPay's Q1/Q2 usage trends (attached) and your ask to reduce runtime throttling during peak settlement windows, I put together a renewal amendment that increases your hosted monthly commit and introduces a new burst bucket for weekend settlement spikes. Key points in the attached proposal:

- Base commit: 120M tokens / month (up from 60M)
- Weekend burst pocket: 15M tokens / month, max burst rate 2x for short windows
- Rate bands: smoother per-token pricing tiers at higher commit (see page 2)
- Soft-throttle behavior: graceful 429 with queued retries for 5s, then fall back to a cheaper model variant if sustained

Attached: Redwood_Renewal_Proposal_OrbitPay_v3.pdf and your usage export.

If this looks good I'll route to Legal for a short amendment and send a DocuSign link. Can we aim for a July 1 effective date?

Thanks Naomi — quick operational summary and suggested options for OrbitPay: 

Option A — Route reservation (recommended)
- Reserve 10% of base commit for /api/v1/settlements via per-route QoS. This is a soft reservation that guarantees tokens will be prioritized in batching and cache hits for that route.
- Weekend burst remains shared but priority routing applies during burst windows.
- No infra changes required; config-level policy in Hosted.
- Impact on cost: no delta beyond proposed commit/burst pricing.

Option B — Dedicated pool (guaranteed)
- Move settlement route to a small Dedicated pool (single tenant) for guaranteed throughput and isolation.
- Minimum monthly commit 200M across the tenant or a dedicated shard; pricing delta +30% on top of base commit.
- Recommended if OrbitPay expects sustained >3x current peaks.

Option C — Conservative: soft-throttle + fallback (lower cost)
- Keep proposal as-is. Soft-throttle will queue and gracefully return 429s with retry guidance. Fallback to cheaper model reduces cost if sustained load occurs.
- Lowest cost but least guaranteed.

Term discount: if OrbitPay bumps to a 12-month term, we can move to a stepped discount: 8% off base per-token rate for the first 6 months, then 5% for months 7-12 (mirrors our phased-commit incentives). Requires commercial approval but is within typical deal comps (I can get signoff).

Attachments: small config snippet (pseudocode) and the proposal is fine.

-Jordan
Principal, Solutions — Redwood Inference
